literal: The right time keeping in mind they will wait, without getting agitated, the world those who aim for.
translation: Those who aim to conquer the world will wait patiently without wavering, biding the right time.
modern: உலகத்தை வெல்ல நினைப்பவர்கள், மனம் கலங்காமல் அதற்குரிய ஏற்ற காலத்தை எதிர்பார்த்துக் காத்திருப்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic patience required for achieving monumental goals. Those who aspire to conquer or rule the entire world ('ஞாலம் கருதுபவர்') do not act impulsively or lose their composure. Instead, they remain completely unagitated ('கலங்காது') and wait ('இருப்பர்') for the most opportune moment ('காலம் கருதி'). Their stillness is not inaction, but a calculated wait for the perfect time to ensure absolute victory.
